nuggets.text: Buckeyes running back Bo Jackson was born Lamar Jackson Jr.; his dad nicknamed him after the two-sport legend.
Julian Sayin's first college start was a 14-7 win over No. 1 Texas in 2025.
Jeremiah Smith opened the Buckeyes' scoring against Ball State with a 48-yard, one-handed, over-the-shoulder touchdown catch.
Jeremiah Smith set FBS true-freshman records for receiving yards and touchdowns in 2024, the year the Buckeyes won the national title.
Buckeyes coach Ryan Day played quarterback at New Hampshire for offensive coordinator Chip Kelly.
Bob Hope and Jack Nicklaus are among the honorary i-dotters in the Ohio State band's Script Ohio.
Script Ohio was once built out of DNA strands, earning a Guinness record as the smallest logo ever made.
Brutus Buckeye debuted in 1965 as a papier-mache nut worn over a student's head and torso, legs sticking out.
The Buckeyes beat Texas twice in 2025: 28-14 in a Cotton Bowl playoff semifinal and 14-7 in the season opener.
The Buckeyes won 24-7 in Austin in 2006 on the way to a perfect regular season.
